items.name: Orchestral texture as landscape
items.description: The orchestral texture doesn't change for dramatic reasons — it changes to describe something physical (mist thickening, wind strengthening, forest deepening). Texture IS the musical narrative, not ju

items.name: Structural organicism — the form grows
items.description: A Sibelius movement doesn't announce its themes and then develop them. Fragments appear, repeat, grow, join together, and at some point you realize the full theme has been present all along in pieces.
